Guidelines:
1. Selection: Selection will be on merit through a written examination and/or interview Conducted
to be heldon Saturday, 07.11.2026. The venue and time will be indicated In the hall ticket, which
will be issued on 06.11.2026 and displayed on Jangaon Distrlct website for transparency.
2. How to Apply: The prescribed application form, along with self-attested copies of SSC, qualifying
certificates, marks memos, study/ residence certificates (1st to 10th class), caste certificate
experience certificate and a passport-size photograph, shall be submitted in person at the District
Employment Office, Room N0:-S-29, Jangaon, from 02.11.2026 to 05.11.2026 between 10.30 AM and
5.00 PM.
3. Terms andConditions:
1 The engagement shall be purely on an outsourcing basis and shall not Confer any right for
regular appointment or permanent absorption in Government service.
2. The period of engagement shall be upto 31.03.2027 or until the actual requirement ceases to
exist, whichever is earlier.
3 The candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and satisfy the
prescribed age limits and eligibility conditions.
4. The remuneration shall be paid as prescribed by the Government, subject to applicable rules
and instructions.
5. The engagement shall be made through the existing outsourcing agency/new outsourcing agency,
as appropriate.
6 Allrelevant original certificates relating to educational qualifications, age and other eligibility
conditions shall be verified before engagement.
7 The selected personnel shall work under the administrative control of the concerned the
Principal, Govt. Medical College,Jangaon and shall discharge the duties assigned to them.
8 The District Collector, Jangaon, reserves the right to cancel or modify the notification in
accordance with Government instructions and administrative requirements.
